note: Real, signed-in Devin web app (thequantexplorer org) captured with Chrome CDP screencast at 1152x648 CSS px, device scale factor 5 (5760x3240 JPEG frames; a few frames in some takes are 5760x2805 after the viewport height changed). Frames are not committed; shots/<take>/frames.jsonl has their Chrome timestamps and events.jsonl the pointer, click, typing and mark events. The cut (edl.json) only speeds up or trims real footage: waiting is compressed, nothing is staged or edited. Cursor and click rings are drawn from the recorded pointer events. No narration, music or title cards; the master has no audio stream.
feature: Inline HTML artifacts (release notes: 'Richer Artifacts, Shown Inline', 'Interactive HTML Reports')
prompt: Map the architecture of github.com/pallets/flask as an interactive diagram (click a module to see what it does) and embed it inline in your reply.
takes: 114a: prompt typed and sent, session watch until the artifact renders
114c: scroll to the diagram, click AppContext, read its panel, click Templating
tools: tutorials/_kit/screenrec/ (screc.mjs recorder, take.mjs, int114.mjs, comp.py compositor, prender.sh)
